sections.heading: F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: restrictions, endorsements and small vehicles
sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: restrictions, endorsements and small vehicles
Knowledge facts: part C holds 34 fact blocks (sec03-F01 onward) from physical pages 18 to 21; part C2 holds 14 confusable and continuation blocks (sec03-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the back-cover publication line, the two-component structure and the 80 percent per-component passing standard from physical pages 1, 10, 68 and 84; the question count and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- IN-RESTRICT-A-COUNT — knowledge-exam question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-RESTRICT-A-TIME — knowledge-exam time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-RESTRICT-D-JCODE — restriction J meaning: specific limitations on the code chart versus driver education restriction elsewhere (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- IN-RESTRICT-D-MCHOURS — motorcycle learner's permit riding window wording (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- IN-RESTRICT-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- IN-RESTRICT-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: endorsement fees, the Ride Safe Indiana provider list and the BMV and RideSafeIndiana.com pages (for example sec03-F18, sec03-R13) can change and must be refreshed from IN.gov/BMV.

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.
